test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (2005) provides work for how many days?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• MGNREGA is a landmark social welfare scheme enacted by the Government of India in **2005**.
 
• Its primary objective is to enhance the **livelihood security **of rural households by providing at least **100 days of guaranteed wage employment **each financial year.
 
• **Key Features:**
 
 
• **Right to Work: **MGNREGA provides rural households the legal right to employment. Any** adult member** of the household willing to do **unskilled **manual labor can apply for work.
 
• **Timely Wages:** Wages are to be paid within **15 days** of the work being completed. The wage rate is determined by the state government in accordance with the Minimum Wage Act.
 
• **Work Availability: **Work must be provided within **15 days** of the demand. If not, the applicant is entitled to an unemployment allowance.
 
• **Decentralized Implementation:** The scheme is implemented through** Gram Panchayats** (local self-government bodies), allowing for local-level decision-making regarding the projects and their implementation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• MGNREGA is a** centrally sponsored scheme**, where the central government provides a significant portion of the funding, especially for wages and material costs, while the state government also contributes.
 
• In some states, the number of guaranteed workdays under MGNREGA has been extended beyond 100 days to counter the impact of economic slowdowns, droughts, or the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• In the **2024 Union Budget**, the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) was allocated** ₹86,000 crore,** the same as the previous year.
